Hi Aoife,

We sincerely apologize for deducting money from your deposit. Our inspection team checked over your Sigma 18-35 once we received it back and noted that there was a scratch on the front element of the lens, and since it wasn't considered to be normal wear and tear we had to deduct $160 from your $600 deposit. If you like, we can send you some pictures of the damage.

In the spirit of good will, however, we would be willing to decrease the damage fee to $100. So if you would like, we can refund the $60 difference to you.

Please let us know how you would like to proceed.

Best,  
Customer Support
